system.description:
Through observation, intrigue and a bit of spin-doctoring, you have learned how to handle appearances, what a speech really means and where deal-making is going on — skills all-consuming in vampire society, where prowess is measured in standing.

Politics aids dealings with mortal society and Influence, discerning hidden motives, brokering deals and setting the debt of a prestation boon — almost a requirement of any harpy. If you know a vampire's name, you may expend a Politics Ability to determine his Status Traits. It also grants insight into bureaucratic power and who is truly in charge.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
